get_contribution_item.description: Read frozen mcp-read/1 sections with get_read_page continuation for components, account breakdown and related History activity hint for one contribution row. Use an exact key from list_contributions with the same query, returnType and groupBy; the hint may identify a broader set of related records when currency or asset-class filters are active, and is not an exact matching breakdown or a second calculation of the amount. May materialize derived snapshots and invalidate ledger previews; no financial facts or provider data are written. Available in existing read_only mode.

groupBy.description: Use the same groupBy as list_contributions

groupKey.description: Exact key from a list_contributions row

limit.description: Initial rows per section, default 25, maximum 100

query.description: Use the same query as list_contributions, including all realized scope and filters

assetClass.description: Asset-class filter. For realized contributions this matches the instrument's current Type metadata.

currency.description: Currency filter. For realized contributions this matches the sell event's native denomination, not account default or output currency.

returnType.description: Use the same returnType as list_contributions

get_contribution_item.name: get_contribution_item

list_contributions.description: Page investment return contributions by instrument, account, currency or asset class. Realized contributions can be filtered by scope and filters, which intersect: currency selects the native sell-event denomination, asset class selects the instrument's current Type, and account/instrument constraints also intersect. Member filtering remains unsupported. Realized rows group by instrument or account only; currency and asset-class filters do not add grouping modes. The returned rows keep nullable amounts/rates, available, status, missingReason and ratedDays/totalDays. Use a row key with get_contribution_item; repeat the same query, returnType and groupBy. Dates are inclusive closed days in the History Origin timezone. May materialize derived snapshots and invalidate ledger previews; no financial facts or provider data are written. Available in existing read_only mode.

groupBy.description: One of instrument, account, currency, asset_class

ordering.description: One of amount_desc, amount_asc, rate_desc, rate_asc, name_asc; defaults to amount_desc

query.description: Inclusive closed-day YYYY-MM-DD range in the History Origin timezone. Scope and filters intersect. For realized, currency matches the sell event's native denomination and assetClass matches current Instrument.Type; member filtering is unsupported.

assetClass.description: Asset-class filter. For realized contributions this matches the instrument's current Type metadata.

currency.description: Currency filter. For realized contributions this matches the sell event's native denomination, not account default or output currency.

returnType.description: One of total_return, realized, unrealized, dividend_interest; unrealized currently reports unavailable

list_contributions.name: list_contributions
